CREATE OR ALTER procedure [dbo].[SimpleAssetSearch] @assetTypeId int, @filter nvarchar(500), @skip int, @take int AS BEGIN drop table if exists #tempTable select A.[UID] as [AssetUid], KP.DisplayPath as [Path] into #tempTable from Asset A inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID inner join graph.AssetNodeDisplayPath KP on KP.ID = a.ID where A.AssetTypeID = @assetTypeID and KP.DisplayPath like @filter order by KP.DisplayPath asc offset @skip rows fetch next @take rows only
select AssetUid as value, case when len([Path]) > 0 then [Path] else 'ERR:MISSING PATH SEGMENTS' end as label from #tempTable END
